# Harborline Partners

Harborline Partners is a hybrid consulting and implementation studio for B2B software companies. Engagements blend senior consultants with a small engineering pod. Technology is core to delivery: every engagement includes a working application, not a slide deck.

## Clients

We work with B2B software companies and multi-location service businesses. Some buyers are founder-led directors; others sponsor a business unit. The page does not state an employee count, and we do not publish a full client roster.

## How an engagement works

Work starts with a discovery workshop and moves into a fixed-scope build on a TypeScript and Postgres stack, with a lightweight admin console that can integrate with the client's CRM. There is no public price list and no self-serve plan.

Book a demo to talk with a partner about scope. Contact sales for a statement of work.

## Proof

Clients mention faster onboarding and cleaner handoffs in short, unnamed testimonials. We do not publish named case studies, quantified ROI, or an integration marketplace.

## Problems clients ask us to take on

- Internal tools are scoped in slides and never shipped.
- CRM and operations data stay disconnected across the engagement.
- Onboarding handoffs depend on a single consultant leaving the project.
